name: Indeed UK
reach_note: Largest UK job site by traffic: indeed.com 34.06M monthly UK visits, Oct 2025 (Semrush public page, vendor).

api.auth: OAuth 2.0 via Indeed account; authorisation server https://secure.indeed.com; dynamic client registration endpoint advertised
sample_fields: Job Search: title, company, location, salary, application URL
api.notes: Live: unauthenticated POST returned 401 with resource_metadata; scopes job_seeker.jobs.search, job_seeker.profile.read, job_seeker.company.details.read, offline_access. Docs say 'available only for Claude Connector'. No apply tool. Publisher API retired.

tos.automated_search: prohibited (scraping); MCP is the sanctioned read route
tos.quote: Job Seeker Terms (29 Sep 2026) prohibit 'any automation, scripting, or bots to automate the Indeed Apply process' (see 01 §C2)

notes: 403 to curl. Use MCP if the owner's test works, otherwise alert emails (rc/clk?jk={jobKey} -> https://uk.indeed.com/viewjob?jk={jk}; pattern unverified for 2026). Resolve to employer ATS before applying.

name: LinkedIn Jobs
reach_note: Main channel for agency and in-house recruiters in professional and tech roles.

api.notes: No public jobs API.

tos.quote: 'Develop, support or use software, devices, scripts, robots or any other means or processes (such as crawlers, browser plugins and add-ons or any other technology) to scrape or copy the Services'

notes: Alert emails: linkedin.com/comm/jobs/view/{jobId}/ -> canonical https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/{jobId}/ (pattern unverified for 2026). 'Open to work' is the inbound signal.

name: Reed
reach_note: Large UK-owned board; also an agency. Traffic figures found were stale (2017).

api.auth: HTTP Basic, API key as username, empty password
api.free_tier: free self-serve key (per third-party guides; not signed up)
api.notes: Live: 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic (auth shape verified, data not, so verified_live false). Filters include postedByRecruitmentAgency, postedByDirectEmployer, permanent, contract, temp, partTime, fullTime, graduate, minimumSalary, maximumSalary. Unknown job ID returns a blank job, not 404. Salary omitted when hidden.

feeds.url_pattern: https://www.reed.co.uk/jobs/{slug}/{jobId} (JobPosting on advert pages; identifier.value = API jobId)

tos.quote: 'You may copy material on the Website for your own private or domestic purposes, but no copying for any commercial or business use is permitted.' robots.txt allows AnthropicBot and GPTBot except /api/ and handlers.

notes: Best machine access of any large UK board. Apply on-site with Reed profile or via externalUrl.

name: Totaljobs
reach_note: Second-largest UK job site by traffic: 6.92M monthly visits, Oct 2025 (Semrush public page, vendor). StepStone UK.

api.notes: No public API.

tos.quote: 6.2.11. You must create, register and operate your account personally, and must not create, access or use an account by means of any bot, script, crawler, scraper or other automated tool or process ... This includes using automated means to submit applications or messages, extract data from the platform, or create multiple or false accounts

notes: Jobseeker terms effective 29 Oct 2026. Profile not searchable by default (6.2.1); searchable profiles show CV and 'Last Active' date. Alert emails contain a personalised link that logs the user in: never store or follow. Advert ID pattern job{8-9 digits}.

notes: Own count: 3 of 25 page-one IDs shared with Totaljobs for 'developer, London'.

name: Adzuna
reach_note: UK-founded aggregator; listings point to source boards and employers.

api.free_tier: free key; 'The free tier is intended for evaluating the API'
api.rate_limit: current terms: shown in account; 2024 archived terms: 25/min, 250/day, 1000/week, 2500/month
api.notes: Spec read live from https://developer.adzuna.com/swagger/spec/test2.json (200). Keyless call returned 400. redirect_url destination unverified. salary_is_predicted=1 means Adzuna's estimate. Legacy XML via content-type=text/xml&legacy_xml=1. Commercial use needs licence; attribution required when publishing.

tos.automated_search: allowed via API under licence terms
tos.quote: 'The free tier is intended for evaluating the API.' Commercial use 'subject to a 14 day trial period' then 'a licence agreement is required'.

notes: Website 403 to curl.

name: GOV.UK Find a job (DWP)
reach_note: DWP board for England, Scotland, Wales; used by Jobcentre work coaches. Being replaced (supplier contract ending).

api.notes: Only employer bulk upload by SFTP. Bulk-uploaded adverts expire after 30 days unless a closing date is set.

notes: Search and terms returned 503 to curl and WebFetch on 3 Nov 2026. gov.uk/find-a-job now links to jobs.service.gov.uk/jobs (TLS failed from here). Advert URLs /details/{id}. Watch for commission-only and self-employed posts.

notes: Google job alerts: take the target from the url= parameter.

name: Teaching Vacancies (DfE)
reach_note: Free DfE service for state schools in England; 4,754 live jobs on 3 Nov 2026 (own count from API meta).

api.notes: Live: 200 JSON, 100 per page, 48 pages, links.next for paging, items are schema.org JobPosting. Query parameters not tested; fetch all and filter locally.

tos.quote: 'You are free to reuse job listing data under the terms of the Open Government Licence ... you must not charge any fee or commission for contacting, interviewing or hiring a respondent to your listing if you have reused Teaching Vacancies data.' (last updated 9 July 2026)

notes: Some schools take applications on-site, others redirect.

name: NHS Jobs
reach_note: NHS England and Wales plus many GP practices; 4,642 results for 'nurse' on 3 Nov 2026.

api.notes: Live: 200 application/xml, 10 per page. location+distance and contractType filter; page pages; sort had no visible effect. NHSBSA navigation lists 'Removed External Jobs Board API', so this may be withdrawn. Employer Self-Serve XML/RSS API documented in NHSBSA .docx files.

notes: Advert pages have no JobPosting JSON-LD. Adverts may close early on volume; poll twice daily. Scotland and NI use separate sites.
